files.description: The repository's rules for every contributor and agent: firmware, protocol, calibration, schematic, licensing and conventions. Review findings cite these rules.
The normative SCPI protocol: commands, responses, report keys, errors and stream records.
The register of what the firmware holds of MISRA C++:2023, its departures and the suppressions with their reasons.
The calibration registry: configurations, instruments, append-only events and records, and the generated index.
